learningObjective: Identify scenarios where INT8 GEMM is NOT faster than FP16 GEMM on an Ampere-class GPU.

canonicalClaims.claim: INT8 GEMM's ~2× Tensor Core TOPS advantage over FP16 is realized only when the kernel is compute-bound; in bandwidth-bound regimes (e.g., M=1 decode with FP16 weights), the compute peak is idle waiting on weight loads and INT8 activations do not reduce the dominant traffic.
conditions: The GPU has both INT8 and FP16 Tensor Core support (Ampere+).
The kernel's arithmetic intensity is below the compute-bound threshold on the target hardware.
nonImplications: Does not imply INT8 GEMM is useless; large-M / compute-bound cases benefit.
Does not imply W4A16 always fixes the M=1 case — very small K or activation-dominated pipelines may not benefit either.

misconceptions.claim: Higher peak TOPS always yields lower wall-clock time.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Wall-clock is min(compute_time, memory_time); a higher TOPS peak is irrelevant if memory is the bottleneck.

misconceptions.claim: cuBLAS disables INT8 Tensor Cores on A100 by default; the observed same runtime is because both cases actually ran FP16.
misconceptions.whyWrong: INT8 Tensor Cores are enabled on A100 via CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32I / cuBLAS Lt; the observation is a genuine bandwidth-bound result.

misconceptions.claim: At M=1, CUDA cannot launch a grid, so the runtimes reflect launch overhead only.
misconceptions.whyWrong: CUDA launches grids of any shape; M=1 just means a small M-axis in the GEMM, launching a normal grid over N and K.

misconceptions.claim: The INT8 kernel is slower due to per-thread quantize/dequantize overhead; removing those ops recovers the speedup.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Quant/dequant is minor compared to weight-loading traffic; the bottleneck is bandwidth, not tiny per-thread ops.

implementationFacts: A100 FP16 Tensor Core peak: ~312 TFLOPS; INT8 peak: ~624 TOPS.
Roofline arithmetic-intensity threshold for A100: FP16 ~156 FLOPs/byte, INT8 ~312 OPs/byte.
performanceScenarios: M=1 decode with 8192-dim weight: activation is 16 KB (FP16) or 8 KB (INT8), weight is 128 MB — activation dtype is <0.1% of traffic.
